fato_historico: 1977: The first free flight of the Space Shuttle Enterprise.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle launch into your own personal orbit. Much like the historic first gliding test of a space vessel, you are invited to trust your structural integrity and soar gracefully through new atmospheric layers. It is a good time to release heavy burdens and embrace the lightness of your potential as you navigate professional goals.
frase_do_dia: Even the grounded goat may dream of touching the silver stars above.
significado_numero: Represents the bridge between solid earthly foundations and vast infinite skies.
conselho: Consider testing your wings on a new project; the sky is not your limit.
